source_text.GH#2699: SECURITY prio 1, PR 2 of #2697: aggregate route migrates to the shared restricted-field walker; join clause closed.

task.description: Implement the design: run_query_aggregate/4 = build_aggregate_request -> FieldPolicy.check_request(:aggregate, exempt?: false) -> Compiler.run_aggregate; delete old helpers and render clause; reword stale comments. No tests.

result.summary: Implemented per design. entities.ex: run_query_aggregate/4 now calls FieldPolicy.check_request(%{user_id, prefix}, :aggregate, request, %{exempt?: false}) binding {:ok, _guard_ok}; deleted check_aggregate_field_restrictions/2, aggregate_request_field_names/1 and the {:aggregate_field_restricted, _} render clause (guard atoms fall through to render_query_error/2 identical 403); reworded moduledoc route row, INV-2 block comment, render comment. compiler.ex compile_aggregate doc reworded. Verified: MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean (no warnings), mix format no changes, mix letflow.check_boundaries OK 1368 edges 0 violations. No tests run or written. Caller grep: no shipped aggregate caller joins on a restricted fk (lib/, web/src, test/fixtures have no aggregate+join callers; existing join tests in entities_query_restricted_filter_test are /query). Existing test that must change: walker test T-39 'the aggregate route is the ONLY remaining direct load_restrictions caller' (~line 1380-1389) and describe 'aggregate route keeps its own check in PR 1' rename; doc comment line 6 of entities_query_restricted_filter_test.exs.
